scope: Canonical relationship graph for the 29 active scientific repositories. Relation type is part of the claim boundary: visually connecting repositories never transfers evidence ownership.

relation_types.handoff: A later project explicitly starts from a question, uncertainty, or bounded object left by the earlier project. Solid directed relation.
relation_types.epistemic: A fixed transformation of scientific questions; no software/data dependency or retroactive validation. Dashed directed relation.
relation_types.abstraction: A specific scientific problem motivates or instantiates a more general theory/method. Dotted directed relation.
relation_types.provenance: Developmental ancestry or origin-of-question relation; not current scientific dependence. Fine dotted directed relation.
relation_types.complement: Two projects are parallel/complementary views of the same umbrella question. Bidirectional relation.
relation_types.component: Parallel companion theory supplies one declared obligation to a synthesis hub; siblings are not sequential chapters. Dotted directed relation.
relation_types.information_flow: Direction in which a bounded scientific/operational object passes, which may differ from research-development chronology. Solid directed relation.

vertical_programmes.surface: present phenotype -> public evolutionary history -> own-data discrimination
vertical_programmes.external_operational_bridge: aza3 <-> ACSP; aza3 declares what evidence/sampling slot is needed, ACSP returns where to look, field truth returns to aza3

vertical_programmes.surface: WHEN/WHERE -> conditional response WHY -> focal phenotype axes
one shared cue -> second trait / escape and mechanism allocation

vertical_programmes.firewall: No chapter output is required by or validates the next; the historical ODSP topology-to-EOG migration is provenance, not the current N2->N3 handoff. ACSP may operationally serve an independently declared empirical sampling need without taking ownership of that biological question.

nonlinear_constellations.firewall: hotarubukuro is not Chapter 3 of FCP/Chun scientific dependence; polymorphism is narrower than the umbrella flower-colour variation programme.

relations.meaning: primary physical record -> blinded physical observer intervention diagnosis
later target/nuisance/observability development -> reusable post-entry methods abstraction; not current InsePi V13 succession
exposure / record entry -> entered process-preserving observation semantics
Paper-1 research lineage -> Paper-2 upstream counterpart

nonlinear_constellations.firewall: Scientific information flow REC->TNOA and research-development lineage TNOA->REC are different relations and must remain separately typed.

meta.role: meta-theory/admission/portfolio registry; not final scientific chapter

nonlinear_constellations.firewall: CCOC, MLTR and MRM are siblings, not CCOC->MLTR->MRM chapters. CED is downstream evidence licensing. theouni wraps relation semantics rather than owning companion proofs.

horizontal_bridges.meaning: specific floral interaction identified set -> general mechanistic identification boundary
what can be identified -> which next observation best reduces the remaining mechanism ambiguity

cross_program_operational_bridges.surface: WHAT to sample <-> WHERE to look

relations.meaning: predeclared biological sampling slot -> bounded candidate search patch
candidate patch -> field verification / private exact-site freeze / individual intake

cross_program_operational_bridges.firewall: aza3 owns taxon, contrast, biological priority, authorization and field truth; ACSP owns search framing, pinned selector and bounded candidate-patch generation. Candidate patch != occupancy != exact sampling site. ACSP evidence never retroactively validates EAzami.

lens_only_no_edge.difference: record entry != post-entry semantics != reportability theorem
empirical/model result != general required-state theorem != portfolio admission semantics
shared viewpoint alone creates no scientific edge

philosophy_path.surface: origin -> record -> boundary -> next observation -> empirical return -> forgetting -> pass forward
